subject: Upcoming Team Building Event
body: Dear Team, I am excited to announce our upcoming team building event scheduled for next Friday. We have planned a fun-filled day with team-building activities, games, and a delicious lunch. This event is a great opportunity for us to bond and strengthen our teamwork. Please mark your calendars and confirm your attendance by replying to this email. Looking forward to a day of fun and camaraderie! Best regards, [Your Name]
